u0: Initial and obligation-free: the yellow key has not been picked up yet and the door remains closed, so the conditional requirement has not triggered. Find and pick up the yellow key; doing so transitions to u1 and activates the obligation to open the door.
u1: Obligation active: the yellow key has been picked up at least once, but the yellow door has not yet been opened. If currently carrying the key, approach and toggle the door; if the key was dropped before opening the door (key_lost), first recover it and then open the door. Opening the door reaches final state u2.
u2: Final and absorbing RM state: the key was acquired and the door was opened after acquisition, satisfying the conditional requirement; no further RM progress is possible. Continue to the green goal to end the environment episode, reopening the door first if it has since been toggled shut.
